title: Roads from the warehouse
text: Welcome to the Old Coast, governor. Nothing reaches the warehouse without a road: lay ten tiles of dirt road leading away from it. Roads cost nothing, and every building they connect delivers to the warehouse.

title: Timber for the colony
text: Every house and workshop needs planks. Build a lumberjack in the forest and a sawmill, and connect both to the warehouse by road. The company sends planks to get you started. Goods beyond the warehouse capacity of the island you choose are lost.

title: Room for settlers
text: Settlers pay taxes, and they are the workers of your workshops. Build four settler houses along the road.

title: Fish for the table
text: Hungry settlers neither grow nor pay their full taxes. Build a fisher on the coast and connect it to the warehouse. Here are more planks for houses. Goods beyond the warehouse capacity of the island you choose are lost.

title: A market square
text: Settlers want a market within reach of their houses. Build a small market and connect it to the road.

title: Warm clothes
text: Well-dressed settlers are content, and content settlers become citizens one day. Build a sheep farm and a wool weaver and connect both to the warehouse.

title: A place of worship
text: Citizens will only settle in a town with a chapel. Build one and connect it to the road.

title: A growing town
text: Fed and housed settlers move in on their own. Grow the archipelago to 120 settlers: with a market and a chapel, citizens may then arrive. These planks are for more houses. Goods beyond the warehouse capacity of the island you choose are lost.

title: A ship of our own
text: Beyond the bay lies a second island with iron in its hills. Build a shipyard on the coast and order a sloop.

title: A second settlement
text: Load the sloop with planks for a warehouse and sail to the second island to found a settlement there. Here are planks for its first buildings. Goods beyond the warehouse capacity of the island you choose are lost.

title: Tools from the second island
text: Citizens' workshops need tools. Mine iron, smelt it and make tools on the second island, and let a sloop on a route bring them home: store ten tools in the start island's warehouse.

title: The first citizens
text: Upgrade a full settler house whose needs are all met into a citizen house. Its walls need stone: quarry it on the start island's stone deposits.
